title: Fused int8 kernel timeout causing KV-cache corruption, accuracy drift and service throttling
creator: Anika Shah
description: Summary: During a high-concurrency production window on 2025-02-11 we observed intermittent fused int8 kernel timeouts that produced partial KV-cache corruption on a subset of requests. Corrupted cache entries produced subtle tokenization/attention mismatches (accuracy drift) for downstream RLHF models and, under repeated retries, caused worker crashloops and upstream service throttles. Fallback to float model variants increased customer token costs and latency. This ticket tracks the follow-ups, mitigations, and validation work to prevent recurrence.
postmortem_summary: Root cause appears to be a race between the fused attention kernel's timeout path and the KV-cache write path when evictions and concurrent flushes occur on quantized tensors. The timeout left stale sentinel metadata in cache buckets; later requests read the sentinel and attempted dequant with incorrect scale ordering, triggering silent drift and in some cases illegal memory accesses that lead to worker restarts. Contributing factors: (1) a recent fused kernel patch changed the error return path without updating the cache invalidation handshake, (2) our canary coverage did not exercise >95th percentile concurrent sequence lengths, and (3) evictions under load were not strongly captured by observability.

2025-02-11 03:23 UTC: On-call routed to runtime team; initial mitigation toggled quantized-kernel-compatibility to fallback float (increased latency/cost observed)
2025-02-11 03:40 UTC: Rollback of fused-kernel-1.18 patch to previous kernel build; 5xx decreased but accuracy drift reports persisted for several customer requests
2025-02-11 05:00 UTC: Traffic progressively throttled on affected Dedicated pools to reduce crashloop amplification
2025-02-11 09:12 UTC: First internal postmortem sketch; triage marked P0 and committed hotfix plan

2025-02-22 11:45 UTC: Hotfix applied to canary pool; monitoring shows no cache-sentinel reads after handshake applied
2025-02-25 08:00 UTC: Canary promoted; gradual rollout initiated with enhanced tracing

comments: Diego Morales (2025-02-12): Initial triage — reproducer harness created. Observed corrupted scale vector when two flushes and an eviction overlap on the same shard. Assigned eng subteam: infer-runtime/kvcache.

Anika Shah (2025-02-14): Added integration test fixture 'concurrent-eviction-adversary' to CI; failing deterministically with fused-kernel-1.18. Link to test: ci.redwood.internal/fixtures/quant-adversary-7
SRE (2025-02-18): Hotfix PR opened and flagged for expedited review. Noted that rollback would still leave some cached bad entries in the cluster; recommend rolling callers with cache flush.
Maeve Lin (Design) (2025-02-19): UX/customer comms draft prepared for status page and affected customers. Shared copy in drive: drive.redwood.com/incident/2025-02-11/comm-draft
Diego Morales (2025-02-22): Canary metrics look stable. Still seeing a 0.02% rate of degraded outputs on legacy quantized-weights path — adding invariant checks before store.
Anika Shah (2025-03-02): Added long-term planning notes and owners below. Will track progress weekly until all items closed.
action_items: A1: Deploy atomic cache invalidation handshake in runtime (owner: Diego) — landed in runtime-1.20 hotfix (PR #3182). Due: 2025-02-22
A2: Build and merge CI adversarial concurrency fixture into presubmit for quantized kernels (owner: Anika) — ensures >95th percentile seq/concurrency combos are tested. Due: 2025-02-28
A3: Add invariant checker at KV cache read that validates scale/zeropoint ordering and rejects stale sentinels (owner: Priya Rao). Due: 2025-03-08
A4: Add histogram metric for 'cache-sentinel-read' and 'cache-invalidation-latency' (owner: Observability team — Luis). Due: 2025-03-01
A5: Run fleet-wide cache scrub job to evict potential corrupted entries and rotate caches after rollout (owner: SRE — Mateo). Due: 2025-03-05
A6: Update canary criteria to include adversarial fixture and stricter accuracy thresholds for quantized models (owner: Diego + QE). Due: 2025-03-10
A7: Create post-deploy customer impact report and billing reconciliation for customers forced to float fallback (owner: Customer Success — Maeve). Due: 2025-03-12
A8: Formalize kernel error-contracts doc and add a small state-machine diagram for invalidation/timeout paths (owner: Runtime Arch — Elena). Due: 2025-03-15
A9: Security review to confirm no info leakage via corrupted caches (owner: Security — Arun). Due: 2025-03-04
